issues.title: Record measured plinth and wall set-out
issues.needed: A dimensioned site check, diagonals, wall faces and the exact drawing revision used on site.
issues.reason: The owner confirms the built plinth matches this PDF. A measured site record is still needed to reconcile the drawing conflicts.

issues.title: Confirm levels, columns and beams
issues.needed: Coordinated structural plans, finished floor levels, beam depths, clear ceiling height and future-floor stair section.
issues.reason: The user reports an engineered foundation, but the drawings have not been supplied. No columns or beam penetrations may be inferred from this interior plan.

issues.title: Resolve the store depth conflict
issues.before: Before setting out the store walls
issues.needed: Confirm whether the 2438 mm printed depth or approximately 2057 mm drawn depth is intended; issue a revised drawing.
issues.reason: Difference is approximately 381 mm. The website preserves the drawn footprint.

issues.title: Resolve the study depth conflict
issues.before: Before setting out the study walls
issues.needed: Confirm the 2057 mm printed depth against the approximately 2108 mm drawn depth.
issues.reason: Do not stretch the model or order a desk from the conflicting labels.

issues.title: Resolve the living-room width conflict
issues.needed: Confirm the 5715 mm printed width against the approximately 5752 mm drawn width.
issues.reason: The rounded drawing comparison is not a site measurement.

issues.title: Issue a complete opening schedule
issues.before: Before door and window openings are built
issues.needed: Rough openings, frames, shutter sizes, sill/head levels, swings, ventilation and safety glazing where applicable.
issues.reason: The source has opening spans but no complete door/window height or swing schedule.

issues.title: Select both fixed cooking appliances
issues.before: Before electrical rough-in and worktop cutting
issues.needed: Exact three-burner gas hob and single-zone induction manuals, cut-outs, edge clearances, under-counter ventilation and service access.
issues.reason: The 190 mm illustrated separation and extractor reservation are proposals, not manufacturer-approved installation dimensions.

issues.title: Coordinate gas and external extraction
issues.needed: Gas source and accessible isolation, tested supply route, selected hood coverage, duct route and an allowed outdoor termination.
issues.reason: No cylinder position, gas pipe size, duct diameter or penetration through structure has been designed.

issues.title: Prove the six-foot bed and two-cot arrangement
issues.needed: Chosen overall six-foot bed frame and both cot products; a measured layout retaining the dressing and store routes, caregiver access and separation from cords/windows.
issues.reason: Two cots are in purchase scope but are not placed or approved. Six-foot width is confirmed. The proposed 1900 × 2100 mm frame leaves about 1052 mm to the lower room face and 1500 mm at the foot; safe circulation is unresolved.

issues.title: Issue coordinated electrical drawings
issues.needed: Appliance loads, board/circuits, protective devices, earthing, outlet and switch set-out, fan clearances, AC services and test requirements.
issues.reason: Lighting dots are intent only. They do not specify wiring, circuit ratings, cable sizes or installation heights.

issues.title: Coordinate wet-area levels and plumbing
issues.needed: Selected sanitaryware and electric-geyser rough-ins, supply/waste/vent routes, pressure-relief discharge, drain positions, falls, finished levels, waterproofing system, thresholds and test method.
issues.reason: Fixture envelopes are proposals. Drainage and waterproofing construction details are not supplied.

issues.title: Approve measured joinery shop drawings
issues.needed: Carcass/panel specifications, actual widths, clearances, hardware, hinges, drawer and door divisions, fixings, cut-outs and maintenance access.
issues.reason: The elevations in this issue show design envelopes, not cutting lists or fabrication approval.
